description: Comprehensive workflow for planning, executing, and measuring a multi-channel marketing campaign from strategy through post-campaign analysis

tasks.title: Define campaign goals and KPIs
tasks.description: Establish clear objectives (brand awareness, lead generation, conversions), target audience, and measurable success metrics

tasks.title: Conduct market research and competitive analysis
tasks.description: Research target audience behaviors, analyze competitor campaigns, identify market opportunities and gaps

tasks.title: Develop campaign strategy and messaging
tasks.description: Create core messaging framework, value propositions, key talking points, and campaign narrative

tasks.title: Plan budget and channel allocation
tasks.description: Allocate budget across channels (digital ads, social, email, content), estimate ROI by channel

tasks.title: Create content calendar and asset plan
tasks.description: Map out content schedule across all channels, identify required assets (videos, graphics, copy)

tasks.title: Design creative assets
tasks.description: Create graphics, videos, ad creatives, landing pages, email templates aligned with campaign messaging

tasks.title: Write campaign copy and content
tasks.description: Develop ad copy, email sequences, blog posts, social media posts, and landing page copy

tasks.title: Set up tracking and analytics
tasks.description: Configure UTM parameters, conversion tracking, attribution models, and analytics dashboards

tasks.title: Review and approve campaign assets
tasks.description: Internal review of all creative assets, copy, and setup. Make final revisions and get stakeholder approval

tasks.title: Configure campaign channels and automation
tasks.description: Set up email automation, ad campaigns, social media scheduling, landing pages, and lead capture forms

tasks.title: Launch campaign across all channels
tasks.description: Go live with ads, publish content, send emails, activate social media - coordinated multi-channel launch

tasks.title: Monitor daily performance metrics
tasks.description: Track campaign performance daily: impressions, clicks, conversions, costs. Identify issues early

tasks.title: Optimize campaign based on data
tasks.description: A/B test variations, pause underperforming ads, scale winning channels, adjust targeting and bids

tasks.title: Nurture leads through follow-up sequences
tasks.description: Engage leads with automated email sequences, retargeting ads, and personalized content

tasks.title: Close campaign and compile final data
tasks.description: Stop all active campaigns, download final metrics, export lead data, close out ad accounts

tasks.title: Analyze campaign ROI and performance
tasks.description: Calculate ROI, cost per acquisition, conversion rates by channel. Compare results to goals and benchmarks

tasks.title: Present results and document learnings
tasks.description: Create campaign report with insights, recommendations, and lessons learned for future campaigns

description: Strategic workflow for launching a product, service, or brand initiative on social media platforms with coordinated content and community engagement

tasks.title: Define social media objectives and target audience
tasks.description: Set goals for reach, engagement, followers, conversions. Define target audience personas and behaviors

tasks.title: Select social media platforms
tasks.description: Choose platforms based on audience presence (Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter, TikTok, Facebook, etc.)

tasks.title: Audit and optimize social profiles
tasks.description: Update profile images, bios, links, highlights. Ensure brand consistency across all platforms

tasks.title: Develop content strategy and themes
tasks.description: Create content pillars, hashtag strategy, posting cadence, engagement tactics, and brand voice guidelines

tasks.title: Create launch content calendar
tasks.description: Plan pre-launch, launch day, and post-launch content with specific dates, times, and platform assignments

tasks.title: Design social media graphics and videos
tasks.description: Create announcement graphics, teaser videos, product showcases, stories, reels, and carousel posts

tasks.title: Write social copy and captions
tasks.description: Craft engaging captions, calls-to-action, hashtags, and messaging for each platform and post

tasks.title: Identify and reach out to influencers
tasks.description: Research relevant influencers, negotiate partnerships, coordinate launch day amplification and content sharing

tasks.title: Build pre-launch buzz with teasers
tasks.description: Post countdown content, behind-the-scenes, sneak peeks to generate anticipation and engagement

tasks.title: Set up paid social advertising
tasks.description: Configure Facebook/Instagram ads, LinkedIn sponsored posts, TikTok ads to amplify organic reach

tasks.title: Execute launch day social media blitz
tasks.description: Post announcement across all platforms, go live on Instagram/Facebook, share launch video, engage with comments

tasks.title: Monitor and respond to social engagement
tasks.description: Reply to comments, messages, and mentions. Foster community engagement and answer questions

tasks.title: Share user-generated content and testimonials
tasks.description: Curate and repost customer content, reviews, unboxings. Build social proof and community

tasks.title: Run post-launch engagement campaigns
tasks.description: Host giveaways, contests, Q&As, polls to maintain momentum and grow following

tasks.title: Analyze social media performance metrics
tasks.description: Review reach, impressions, engagement rate, follower growth, click-through rates, conversions by platform

tasks.title: Create launch performance report
tasks.description: Compile results vs goals, top performing content, audience insights, recommendations for ongoing strategy

description: End-to-end workflow for planning and executing a marketing event from concept through post-event follow-up and ROI analysis

tasks.title: Define event objectives and target audience
tasks.description: Establish event goals (leads, brand awareness, partnerships), define target attendees, and success criteria

tasks.title: Determine event format and budget
tasks.description: Choose event type (conference, workshop, webinar, trade show), set budget for venue, catering, marketing, etc.

tasks.title: Select and book venue
tasks.description: Research venues, conduct site visits, negotiate contracts, book space and confirm dates

tasks.title: Develop event agenda and program
tasks.description: Create schedule with sessions, speakers, breaks. Plan content flow and attendee experience

tasks.title: Secure speakers and presenters
tasks.description: Identify, invite, and confirm keynote speakers, panelists, workshop leaders. Coordinate their requirements

tasks.title: Arrange catering and vendors
tasks.description: Book catering services, audio-visual equipment, photographers, decorators, and other event vendors

tasks.title: Create event branding and materials
tasks.description: Design event logo, banners, signage, name badges, programs, swag, presentation templates

tasks.title: Set up event registration system
tasks.description: Configure registration platform, payment processing, email confirmations, waitlist management

tasks.title: Launch event marketing campaign
tasks.description: Promote event via email, social media, paid ads, partner networks, press releases

tasks.title: Manage registrations and communications
tasks.description: Send confirmation emails, reminders, pre-event information, parking/travel details to registrants

tasks.title: Coordinate speaker logistics
tasks.description: Confirm speaker A/V needs, travel arrangements, hotel bookings, session timing, and presentation files

tasks.title: Finalize event run-of-show
tasks.description: Create detailed timeline, staff assignments, contingency plans, emergency procedures, contact lists

tasks.title: Conduct pre-event venue walkthrough
tasks.description: Visit venue with team and vendors, test A/V, finalize room setup, signage placement, registration flow

tasks.title: Execute event day operations
tasks.description: Manage registration, coordinate vendors, support speakers, handle issues, ensure smooth attendee experience

tasks.title: Capture event content and photos
tasks.description: Record sessions, photograph event highlights, gather attendee testimonials, collect presentation files

tasks.title: Send post-event thank you emails
tasks.description: Thank attendees, speakers, sponsors. Share session recordings, slides, and next steps

tasks.title: Follow up with leads and attendees
tasks.description: Engage hot leads with sales outreach, nurture attendees with relevant content, schedule follow-up meetings

tasks.title: Analyze event ROI and performance
tasks.description: Calculate cost per lead, attendee satisfaction scores, lead quality, conversion rates, revenue attribution

tasks.title: Create event recap and learnings report
tasks.description: Document successes, challenges, budget actuals, attendee feedback, recommendations for future events
